Location.
1.
The ATM machine will be placed in an area determined by the Ice & Events Center, and
Provider will anchor the ATM machine to the floor.
2.
The ATM machine will operate ona cellular modem andwill not require a telephone line
or internet connection.The ATM should remain powered on 24 hours a day,7 days a week,
365 days a year.
Maintenance: Service.
1.
Provider will keep the ATMmachine clean and in working order at all times.
2.
If the ATM machine malfunctions, Ice&Event Center staff will contact Provider as soon
as possible and report theissue toensure theATM machine remains operable.
Fees: Revenue Distribution: Refunds.
1.
Provider will charge a$3.00 surcharge for cash withdrawal transactions.
2.
There will be nofees charged for balance checks or balance transfer transactions.
3.
Provider will provide documentation for the surcharge transactions and provide the
surcharge payment to the City the first week of every month.
4.
The revenue paid to the City will be $1.50 per surcharge transaction, and the revenue paid
to the Provider will be$1.50 per surcharge transaction.
4.
Ice&Events Centerstaff will not provide refunds to customers using the ATM machine that
claim they did not receive all the cash requested and their account was charged for the entire
amount. Ice & Events Center staff will need to contact Provider immediately to resolve any
customer issues.
Additional ATM Machines.
1.
If the City requests additional ATM machines required for large events, Provider will need
no less than thirty (30) days notice from the City.However, Provider cannot guarantee
additional ATM machines canbe suppliedfor theevents.
2.
If additional ATM machines are supplied for large events, revenue paid to the City will be
$1.00 per surcharge transaction, and the revenue paid to the Provider will be $2.00 per
surcharge transaction.
